title: Graph-normalized ordinary etale compact-support comparison datum
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$. Work with schemes of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme] and ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. A graph-normalized compact-support comparison datum consists of the following simultaneous data. For every separated etale morphism $v:V\to T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] between Noetherian schemes and every compactification $c=(j,r)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], it supplies an isomorphism $c_{v,c}:Rr_*Dj_!\simeq Dv_{\Sigma!}$ from ordinary compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support] to derived sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], and a sheaf map $a_{v,c}:v_{\Sigma!}\to r_*j_!$. The composite of $a_{v,c}$ with the canonical map $r_*j_!\to v_*$ is the graph-extension sum-to-direct-image map; on each homotopy representative, $c_{v,c}^{-1}$ is the degreewise descent of $a_{v,c}$ followed by the total right-derived unit. For quasi-compact $v$, the actual proper-exchange/open-extension base-change square equals the square for the inverse sum-extension exchange, and the corresponding pasted square holds for two successive changes of base, using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Under a proper refinement with Noetherian coarser compactification scheme the comparisons commute with the proper/open direct-image composition normalized over $V$. For the identity compactification of an identity morphism the comparison is the canonical identity comparison. Finally, for each right adjoint $G$ of $Rr_*Dj_!$ with specified adjunction, there is a unique isomorphism $G\simeq v^*$ whose counit, transported by $c_{v,c}$, is exactly the degreewise sum/evaluation counit. This defines the datum only; no existence of such a family is asserted.
